evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26hsn (AT2026qbk) in galaxy ESO 153- G 007 at magnitude m_o = 17.64 +/- 0.10. At a distance of 85 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61215.40 (2026-06-24.40) with an absolute magnitude of M = -17.1 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 61190.19. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
